<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function widgetcontroller($scope, $rootScope, $timeout) {
  var c = this;

  c.filters = {
    // Company Code (Segment) — always one of the user's role-allowed codes,
    // there is no "All" option, same pattern as the trade widget.
    segment: c.data.selectedSegment || '',
    zones: [],    // Customer Group
    regions: [],  // CG4
    depots: [],   // Sales Office
    status: '',
    period: c.data.selectedPeriod || 'latest',
    customFrom: '',
    customTo: '',
    search: ''
  };

  c.rowsPerPageOptions = [10, 15, 20, 50, 100];
  c.pagination = { currentPage: 1, rowsPerPage: 10 };
  c.hoverIndex = -1;
  c.showTooltip = false;
  c.tooltipLeft = 0;
  c.tooltipTop = 0;
  c.paginatedRequests = [];
  c.kpiFilter = '';

  // ===================== CUSTOMER GROUP (Zone) multiselect =====================
  c.zoneDropdownOpen = false;
  c.zoneSearch = '';

  c.closeAllDropdowns = function() {
      c.zoneDropdownOpen = false;
      c.regionDropdownOpen = false;
      c.depotDropdownOpen = false;
  };

  c.openZoneDropdown = function() { c.zoneDropdownOpen = true; };
  c.closeZoneDropdown = function() { c.zoneDropdownOpen = false; };

  c.toggleZone = function(z) {
      var idx = c.filters.zones.indexOf(z);
      if (idx === -1) {
          c.filters.zones.push(z);
      } else {
          c.filters.zones.splice(idx, 1);
      }
      // Customer Group changed -> clear dependent CG4/Sales Office (cascade)
      c.filters.regions = [];
      c.filters.depots = [];
      c.zoneSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.selectAllZones = function() {
      var allZones = (c.data && c.data.filterOpts && c.data.filterOpts.zones) || [];
      c.filters.zones = allZones.slice();
      c.filters.regions = [];
      c.filters.depots = [];
      c.zoneSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.clearAllZones = function() {
      c.filters.zones = [];
      c.filters.regions = [];
      c.filters.depots = [];
      c.zoneSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.isZoneSelected = function(z) {
      return c.filters.zones.indexOf(z) !== -1;
  };

  c.getFilteredZones = function() {
      var all = (c.data && c.data.filterOpts && c.data.filterOpts.zones) || [];
      var term = (c.zoneSearch || '').toLowerCase();
      if (!term) return all;
      return all.filter(function(z) { return String(z).toLowerCase().indexOf(term) !== -1; });
  };

  c.getZoneDisplayText = function() {
      if (!c.filters.zones || c.filters.zones.length === 0) return 'All Customer Groups';
      if (c.filters.zones.length === 1) return c.filters.zones[0];
      return c.filters.zones.length + ' groups selected';
  };

  // ===================== CG4 (Region) multiselect (cascades off Customer Group) =====================
  c.regionDropdownOpen = false;
  c.regionSearch = '';

  c.openRegionDropdown = function() { c.regionDropdownOpen = true; };
  c.closeRegionDropdown = function() { c.regionDropdownOpen = false; };

  c.toggleRegion = function(r) {
      var idx = c.filters.regions.indexOf(r);
      if (idx === -1) {
          c.filters.regions.push(r);
      } else {
          c.filters.regions.splice(idx, 1);
      }
      // CG4 changed -> clear dependent Sales Office (cascade)
      c.filters.depots = [];
      c.regionSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.selectAllRegions = function() {
      var allRegions = (c.data && c.data.filterOpts && c.data.filterOpts.regions) || [];
      c.filters.regions = allRegions.slice();
      c.filters.depots = [];
      c.regionSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.clearAllRegions = function() {
      c.filters.regions = [];
      c.filters.depots = [];
      c.regionSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.isRegionSelected = function(r) {
      return c.filters.regions.indexOf(r) !== -1;
  };

  c.getFilteredRegions = function() {
      var all = (c.data && c.data.filterOpts && c.data.filterOpts.regions) || [];
      var term = (c.regionSearch || '').toLowerCase();
      if (!term) return all;
      return all.filter(function(r) { return String(r).toLowerCase().indexOf(term) !== -1; });
  };

  c.getRegionDisplayText = function() {
      if (!c.filters.regions || c.filters.regions.length === 0) return 'All CG4';
      if (c.filters.regions.length === 1) return c.filters.regions[0];
      return c.filters.regions.length + ' CG4 selected';
  };

  // ===================== SALES OFFICE (Depot) multiselect =====================
  c.depotDropdownOpen = false;
  c.depotSearch = '';

  c.openDepotDropdown = function() { c.depotDropdownOpen = true; };
  c.closeDepotDropdown = function() { c.depotDropdownOpen = false; };

  c.toggleDepot = function(d) {
      var idx = c.filters.depots.indexOf(d);
      if (idx === -1) {
          c.filters.depots.push(d);
      } else {
          c.filters.depots.splice(idx, 1);
      }
      c.depotSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.selectAllDepots = function() {
      var allDepots = (c.data && c.data.filterOpts && c.data.filterOpts.depots) || [];
      c.filters.depots = allDepots.slice();
      c.depotSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.clearAllDepots = function() {
      c.filters.depots = [];
      c.depotSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.isDepotSelected = function(d) {
      return c.filters.depots.indexOf(d) !== -1;
  };

  c.getFilteredDepots = function() {
      var all = (c.data && c.data.filterOpts && c.data.filterOpts.depots) || [];
      var term = (c.depotSearch || '').toLowerCase();
      if (!term) return all;
      return all.filter(function(d) { return String(d).toLowerCase().indexOf(term) !== -1; });
  };

  c.getDepotDisplayText = function() {
      if (!c.filters.depots || c.filters.depots.length === 0) return 'All Sales Offices';
      if (c.filters.depots.length === 1) return c.filters.depots[0];
      return c.filters.depots.length + ' offices selected';
  };

  c.onSegmentChange = function() {
      c.filters.zones = [];
      c.filters.regions = [];
      c.filters.depots = [];
      c.zoneSearch = '';
      c.regionSearch = '';
      c.depotSearch = '';
      c.applyFilters();
  };

  c.onPeriodChange = function() {
    if (c.filters.period !== 'custom') {
      c.applyFilters();
    }
  };

  // ========================================================
  // Broadcast Payload -> non-trade request detail widget listens for this
  // ========================================================
  c.openRequestDetail = function(r) {
      if (!r || !r.requestCode) return;
      $rootScope.clmPendingRequestNumber = r.requestCode;
      $rootScope.$broadcast('clm.request.selected', { number: r.requestCode });
      $rootScope.$broadcast('clm.switch.tab', 'request_detail');
  };

  c.applyFilters = function() {
    if (c.filters.period === 'custom' && (!c.filters.customFrom || !c.filters.customTo)) {
      return;
    }
    c.pagination.currentPage = 1;
    c.data.filters = {
      segment: c.filters.segment,
      zones: c.filters.zones,
      regions: c.filters.regions,
      depots: c.filters.depots,
      status: c.filters.status,
      period: c.filters.period,
      customFrom: c.filters.customFrom,
      customTo: c.filters.customTo
    };
    c.server.update().then(function() {
      if (c.data && c.data.selectedSegment) {
          c.filters.segment = c.data.selectedSegment;
      }
      c.runSearch();
    });
  };

  c.setKpiFilter = function(state) {
      if (c.kpiFilter === state) {
          c.kpiFilter = '';
      } else {
          c.kpiFilter = state;
          c.pagination.currentPage = 1;
          $timeout(function() {
              var el = document.getElementById('clmRequestsTableContainer');
              if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
          }, 100);
      }
      c.runSearch();
  };

  c.runSearch = function() {
    var term = (c.filters.search || '').toString().toLowerCase().trim();

    (c.data.requests || []).forEach(function(r) {
      var isHidden = false;

      if (term) {
        var fields = [r.requestCode, r.customerCode, r.customerName, r.pan];
        var matched = fields.some(function(f) {
          return (f || '').toString().toLowerCase().indexOf(term) > -1;
        });
        if (!matched) isHidden = true;
      }

      if (!isHidden && c.kpiFilter) {
          if (c.kpiFilter === 'deviated') {
              if (!r.isDeviation) isHidden = true;
          } else {
              var statLower = (r.status || '').toLowerCase();
              if (c.kpiFilter === 'pending' && statLower.indexOf('submit') === -1) isHidden = true;
              if (c.kpiFilter === 'approved' && statLower.indexOf('approv') === -1) isHidden = true;
              if (c.kpiFilter === 'sendback' && statLower.indexOf('return') === -1 && statLower.indexOf('send') === -1) isHidden = true;
              if (c.kpiFilter === 'rejected' && statLower.indexOf('reject') === -1) isHidden = true;
          }
      }

      r._hidden = isHidden;
    });

    c.pagination.currentPage = 1;
    c.updatePaginatedRequests();
  };

  c.updatePaginatedRequests = function() {
    var visible = (c.data.requests || []).filter(function(r) { return !r._hidden; });
    var start = (c.pagination.currentPage - 1) * c.pagination.rowsPerPage;
    var end = start + c.pagination.rowsPerPage;
    c.paginatedRequests = visible.slice(start, end);
  };

  c.getVisibleRecordsCount = function() {
    return (c.data.requests || []).filter(function(r) { return !r._hidden; }).length;
  };

  c.getTotalPages = function() {
    var visible = (c.data.requests || []).filter(function(r) { return !r._hidden; });
    return Math.ceil(visible.length / c.pagination.rowsPerPage) || 1;
  };

  c.getPageNumbers = function() {
    var total = c.getTotalPages();
    var pages = [];
    var maxVisible = 5;
    var start = Math.max(1, c.pagination.currentPage - Math.floor(maxVisible / 2));
    var end = Math.min(total, start + maxVisible - 1);

    if (end - start < maxVisible - 1) {
      start = Math.max(1, end - maxVisible + 1);
    }

    for (var i = start; i <= end; i++) {
      pages.push(i);
    }
    return pages;
  };

  c.previousPage = function() {
    if (c.pagination.currentPage > 1) { c.pagination.currentPage--; c.updatePaginatedRequests(); }
  };
  c.nextPage = function() {
    if (c.pagination.currentPage < c.getTotalPages()) { c.pagination.currentPage++; c.updatePaginatedRequests(); }
  };
  c.goToPage = function(pageNum) {
    c.pagination.currentPage = pageNum; c.updatePaginatedRequests();
  };
  c.onRowsPerPageChange = function() {
    c.pagination.currentPage = 1; c.updatePaginatedRequests();
  };

  $scope.$watch('c.filters.search', c.runSearch);

  // ===================== Approval Pipeline chart helpers (unchanged) =====================
  c.chartX = function(i) {
    var n = (c.data.chart.months || []).length;
    if (n <= 1) return 40;
    return 40 + (i * (860 / (n - 1)));
  };

  c.linePoints = function(key) {
    var months = c.data.chart.months || [];
    var series = (c.data.chart.series || {})[key] || [];
    var max = c.data.chart.max || 1;
    var pts = [];
    months.forEach(function(m, i) {
      var v = series[i] || 0;
      pts.push(c.chartX(i) + ',' + (220 - (v / max) * 200));
    });
    return pts.join(' ');
  };

  c.onMouseOverMonth = function(ev, index) {
    c.hoverIndex = index;
    c.showTooltip = true;
    var targetRect = ev.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    var containerRect = ev.currentTarget.closest('.clm-chart-body').getBoundingClientRect();
    c.tooltipLeft = (targetRect.left + targetRect.width / 2) - containerRect.left;
    c.tooltipTop = (targetRect.top - containerRect.top) + 40;
  };

  c.onMouseLeaveChart = function() { c.hoverIndex = -1; c.showTooltip = false; };

  // ===================== NEW: Total Outstanding MoM Trend chart helpers =====================
  c.momChartX = function(i) {
    var n = (c.data.momTrend && c.data.momTrend.months || []).length;
    if (n <= 1) return 40;
    return 40 + (i * (860 / (n - 1)));
  };

  c.momPointY = function(i) {
    var series = (c.data.momTrend && c.data.momTrend.series) || [];
    var max = (c.data.momTrend && c.data.momTrend.max) || 1;
    var v = series[i] || 0;
    return 220 - (v / max) * 200;
  };

  c.momLinePoints = function() {
    var months = (c.data.momTrend && c.data.momTrend.months) || [];
    var pts = [];
    months.forEach(function(m, i) {
      pts.push(c.momChartX(i) + ',' + c.momPointY(i));
    });
    return pts.join(' ');
  };

  // ===================== NEW: Ageing Breakdown (6M) stacked bar helpers =====================
  c.ageingBarX = function(i) {
    var n = (c.data.ageingBreakdown && c.data.ageingBreakdown.months || []).length;
    if (n <= 1) return 40;
    return 40 + (i * (860 / (n - 1)));
  };

  c.ageingBarWidth = function() {
    var n = (c.data.ageingBreakdown && c.data.ageingBreakdown.months || []).length;
    return (860 / (n - 1 || 1)) * 0.5;
  };

  // Returns the 4 stacked rects (current, 31-60, 61-90, >90) for month index i
  c.ageingSegmentRects = function(i) {
    var ab = c.data.ageingBreakdown;
    if (!ab || !ab.series) return [];
    var s = ab.series;
    var max = ab.max || 1;
    var baseline = 220;
    var scale = 200 / max;
    var w = c.ageingBarWidth();
    var x = c.ageingBarX(i) - w / 2;

    var segments = [
      { key: '0-30D',  v: (s.current && s.current[i]) || 0, cls: 'bar-current' },
      { key: '31-60D', v: (s.b31_60  && s.b31_60[i])  || 0, cls: 'bar-3160' },
      { key: '61-90D', v: (s.b61_90  && s.b61_90[i])  || 0, cls: 'bar-6190' },
      { key: '>90D',   v: (s.gt90    && s.gt90[i])    || 0, cls: 'bar-gt90' }
    ];

    var yCursor = baseline;
    var rects = [];
    segments.forEach(function(seg) {
      var h = seg.v * scale;
      yCursor -= h;
      rects.push({ x: x, y: yCursor, width: w, height: h, cls: seg.cls, value: seg.v, key: seg.key });
    });
    return rects;
  };

  // ===================== NEW: Region Risk Matrix badge class =====================
  c.riskClass = function(level) {
    var l = (level || '').toLowerCase();
    if (l === 'critical') return 'risk-critical';
    if (l === 'elevated') return 'risk-elevated';
    return 'risk-normal';
  };

  c.statusClass = function(status) {
    var s = (status || '').toLowerCase();
    if (s.indexOf('submit') > -1 || s.indexOf('pend') > -1) return 'st-submitted';
    if (s.indexOf('approv') > -1) return 'st-approved';
    if (s.indexOf('return') > -1 || s.indexOf('send') > -1) return 'st-sendback';
    if (s.indexOf('reject') > -1) return 'st-rejected';
    return 'st-default';
  };

  // NOTE: "segment" here is Company Code. Kept generic since company codes
  // won't map to the Cement/RMC/BPD naming used in trade — falls back to
  // a neutral badge class unless a code happens to contain one of these words.
  c.segClass = function(seg) {
    var s = (seg || '').toLowerCase();
    if (s.indexOf('cement') > -1) return 'seg-cement';
    if (s.indexOf('rmc') > -1) return 'seg-rmc';
    if (s.indexOf('bpd') > -1) return 'seg-bpd';
    return 'seg-default';
  };

  c.yAxisTicks = [];
  for (var val = 0; val <= 8; val++) {
    var yCoord = 220 - (val / 8) * 200;
    c.yAxisTicks.push({ label: val, y: yCoord });
  }

  c.updatePaginatedRequests();
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.clm-dash {
  font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  color: #1f2937;
  font-size: 13px;
  padding: 20px;

  /* ===================== Filter Card ===================== */
  .clm-filter-card {
    margin: 0 0 16px 0;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e3e6eb;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  .clm-filter-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    overflow-x: visible;
  }

  .clm-filter-field {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #5b6470;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    font-weight: normal;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    position: relative;

    select {
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 160px;
      height: 34px;
      font-size: 13px;

      padding: 0 10px;
      outline: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;

      &:hover { border-color: #a0aec0; background-color: #f7fafc; }
    }
  }

  /* ---------- Multiselect (Customer Group / CG4 / Sales Office) ---------- */

  .clm-multiselect-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 160px;
  }

  .clm-multiselect-trigger {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    width: 100%;
    height: 34px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #ffffff;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;

    &:hover { border-color: #a0aec0; }
  }

  .clm-multiselect-container.open .clm-multiselect-trigger {

    border-bottom-left-radius: 6px;
    border-bottom-right-radius: 6px;

    max-height: 280px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .clm-multiselect-actions {

    padding: 0 10px;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e6eb;
    font-size: 12px;
    outline: none;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 4px 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    max-height: 180px;

    li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

    border-radius: 3px;

      border-color: #1c4e9c;

      &::after {

        left: 3px;
        top: 1px;
        width: 4px;
        height: 7px;
        border: solid #fff;
        border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
        transform: rotate(45deg);
      }

  .clm-dropdown-empty {
    color: #a0aec0 !important;
    cursor: default !important;
    font-style: italic;
    &:hover { background-color: #ffffff !important; }
  }

  /* ---------- Custom Date Range ---------- */
  .clm-custom-range {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    flex-direction: row;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;

    input[type="date"] {
      height: 30px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      font-size: 12px;

        zones:    distinctValues('zone',   { segment: segmentFilter }),
        regions:  distinctValues('region', { segment: segmentFilter, zones: zonesSelected }),
        depots:   distinctValues('depot',  { segment: segmentFilter, zones: zonesSelected, regions: regionsSelected }),
        periods: [
            { label: 'All Time (Latest)', value: 'latest' },
            { label: 'This Month', value: 'current_month' },
            { label: 'Last Month', value: 'previous_month' },
            { label: 'This Year', value: 'current_year' },
            { label: 'Last Year', value: 'last_year' },
            { label: 'Custom Range…', value: 'custom' }
        ]
    };

    // =========================================================
    // Resolve the list of customer_codes matching the full current filter
    // scope (segment + zones + regions + depots).
    // Now expanded to include ALL customer records sharing the same PAN.
    // =========================================================
    var scopedCodes = [];
    var scopedSysIds = []; // Added for safety if field is a reference
    var validPans = {};

    // First pass: identify valid sites and PANs based on the user's filters
    allCustomers.forEach(function(rec) {
        if (segmentFilter && norm(rec.segment) !== norm(segmentFilter)) return;
        if (zonesSelected.length && zoneNotIn(rec.zone, zonesSelected)) return;
        if (regionsSelected.length && zoneNotIn(rec.region, regionsSelected)) return;
        if (depotsSelected.length && zoneNotIn(rec.depot, depotsSelected)) return;

        if (rec.code) scopedCodes.push(rec.code);
        if (rec.sysId) scopedSysIds.push(rec.sysId);
        if (rec.pan) validPans[norm(rec.pan)] = true;
    });

    // Second pass: include ANY customer record (like Parent records) that shares a valid PAN
    allCustomers.forEach(function(rec) {
        if (rec.pan && validPans[norm(rec.pan)]) {
            if (rec.code && scopedCodes.indexOf(rec.code) === -1) {
                scopedCodes.push(rec.code);
            }
            if (rec.sysId && scopedSysIds.indexOf(rec.sysId) === -1) {
                scopedSysIds.push(rec.sysId);
            }
        }
    });

    function applyAppFilters(gr) {
        if (scopedCodes.length) {
            var qc = gr.addQuery(F_CUSTOMER_CODE, 'IN', scopedCodes);
            // Also check sys_ids in case F_CUSTOMER_CODE is a reference or GlideList
            qc.addOrCondition(F_CUSTOMER_CODE, 'IN', scopedSysIds);
        } else {
            gr.addQuery(F_CUSTOMER_CODE, '__none__');
        }
    }

    // =========================================================
    // Approval chain — placeholders, not covered by your mapping. Confirm
    // and replace with the real approver fields on x_birl3_clm_non_trade_clr.
    // =========================================================
    var NON_TRADE_CHAIN = [
      { label: 'Step 1', field: 'u_approver_step1' },  // <-- CONFIRM
      { label: 'Step 2', field: 'u_approver_step2' },  // <-- CONFIRM
      { label: 'Step 3', field: 'u_approver_step3' },  // <-- CONFIRM
      { label: 'Final',  field: 'u_approver_final' }   // <-- CONFIRM
    ];

    function getPendingAtStep(gr) {
      var mapBySysId = {};
      var lastSubmitted = gr.getValue('u_last_submitted_on'); // <-- CONFIRM field exists

      var saGR = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
      var saQuery = saGR.addQuery('sysapproval', gr.sys_id);
      saQuery.addOrCondition('document_id', gr.sys_id);
      if (lastSubmitted) saGR.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', lastSubmitted);
      saGR.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
      saGR.query();

      while (saGR.next()) {
        var aSysId = saGR.getValue('approver') + '';
        var aRaw   = (saGR.getValue('state') + '').toLowerCase().trim();
        var aSt    = (aRaw === 'approved') ? 'approved' : (aRaw === 'rejected') ? 'rejected' : (aRaw === 'cancelled') ? 'returned' : 'pending';
        if (typeof mapBySysId[aSysId] === 'undefined') mapBySysId[aSysId] = aSt;
      }

      for (var i = 0; i < NON_TRADE_CHAIN.length; i++) {
        var entry = NON_TRADE_CHAIN[i];
        var rawVal = (gr.getValue(entry.field) || '').trim();
        if (!rawVal || rawVal === '' || rawVal === 'null' || rawVal === 'undefined') continue;

        var stepState = mapBySysId[rawVal] || 'pending';
        if (stepState === 'pending') {
          var approverName = '';
          try { approverName = gr[entry.field].getDisplayValue() + ''; } catch(e) { approverName = entry.label; }
          return approverName || entry.label;
        }
      }
      return '';
    }

    function monthRangeQuery(gr, dateField, year, month) {
      var startGdt = new GlideDateTime();
      startGdt.setValue(year + '-' + pad(month) + '-01 00:00:00');
      var endMonth = month + 1, endYear = year;
      if (endMonth > 12) { endMonth = 1; endYear = year + 1; }
      var endGdt = new GlideDateTime();
      endGdt.setValue(endYear + '-' + pad(endMonth) + '-01 00:00:00');
      gr.addQuery(dateField, '>=', startGdt);
      gr.addQuery(dateField, '<', endGdt);
    }

    function getFilteredStatusOptions(table, field) {
      var arr = [], seen = {};
      var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
      gr.addQuery('name', table);
      gr.addQuery('element', field);
      gr.addQuery('inactive', false);
      gr.orderBy('sequence');
      gr.query();
      while (gr.next()) {
        var v = gr.getValue('value');
        var lbl = gr.getValue('label') || '';
        if (!v || seen[v]) continue;
        var lower = lbl.toLowerCase();
        if (!ALLOWED_STATUS_KEYWORDS.some(function(kw) { return lower.indexOf(kw) > -1; })) continue;
        seen[v] = true;
        arr.push({ value: v, label: lbl });
      }
      return arr;
    }

    function resolveCustomer(reqGr) {
        var rawVal  = clean(reqGr.getValue(F_CUSTOMER_CODE));
        var dispVal = clean(reqGr.getDisplayValue(F_CUSTOMER_CODE));

        // Handle comma-separated values if multiple sites are selected on one request
        var firstRaw = rawVal.split(',')[0].trim();
        var firstDisp = dispVal.split(',')[0].trim();

        if (firstRaw && custByCode[firstRaw]) return custByCode[firstRaw];
        if (firstRaw && custBySysId[firstRaw]) return custBySysId[firstRaw];
        if (firstDisp && custByCode[firstDisp]) return custByCode[firstDisp];

        var key = norm(firstDisp);
        if (key) {
            for (var i = 0; i < allCustomers.length; i++) {
                if (norm(allCustomers[i].name) === key || norm(allCustomers[i].code) === key) return allCustomers[i];
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    // =========================================================
    // Outstanding / ageing snapshot helpers
    // =========================================================
    function readAgeingRecord(gr) {
      return {
        total:  parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_OUT_TOTAL)) || 0,
        a0_3:   parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_AGE_0_3))   || 0,
        a4_7:   parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_AGE_4_7))   || 0,
        a8_21:  parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_AGE_8_21))  || 0,
        a22_30: parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_AGE_22_30)) || 0,
        a31_45: parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_AGE_31_45)) || 0,
        a46_60: parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_AGE_46_60)) || 0,
        a61_75: parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_AGE_61_75)) || 0,
        a76_90: parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_AGE_76_90)) || 0,
        gt90:   parseFloat(gr.getValue(F_AGE_GT90))  || 0,
        snapshotDate: gr.getValue(F_OUT_CREATED)
      };
    }

    function buildLatestSnapshotMap(codesScope) {
      var map = {};
      var gr = new GlideRecord(OUTSTANDING_TABLE);
      if (codesScope && codesScope.length) gr.addQuery(F_OUT_CUSTOMER, 'IN', codesScope);
      gr.orderByDesc(F_OUT_CREATED);
      gr.query();
      while (gr.next()) {
        var code = clean(gr.getValue(F_OUT_CUSTOMER));
        if (code && typeof map[code] === 'undefined') map[code] = readAgeingRecord(gr);
      }
      return map;
    }

    function buildSnapshotMapForMonth(codesScope, year, month) {
      var start = new GlideDateTime();
      start.setValue(year + '-' + pad(month) + '-01 00:00:00');
      var endMonth = month + 1, endYear = year;
      if (endMonth > 12) { endMonth = 1; endYear += 1; }
      var end = new GlideDateTime();
      end.setValue(endYear + '-' + pad(endMonth) + '-01 00:00:00');

      var map = {};
      var gr = new GlideRecord(OUTSTANDING_TABLE);
      if (codesScope && codesScope.length) gr.addQuery(F_OUT_CUSTOMER, 'IN', codesScope);
      gr.addQuery(F_OUT_CREATED, '>=', start);
      gr.addQuery(F_OUT_CREATED, '<', end);
      gr.orderByDesc(F_OUT_CREATED);
      gr.query();
      while (gr.next()) {
        var code = clean(gr.getValue(F_OUT_CUSTOMER));
        if (code && typeof map[code] === 'undefined') map[code] = readAgeingRecord(gr);
      }
      return map;
    }

    function getLastNMonthKeys(n) {
      var arr = [];
      var nowStr = new GlideDateTime().getValue();
      var y = parseInt(nowStr.substr(0, 4), 10);
      var m = parseInt(nowStr.substr(5, 2), 10);
      for (var i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var mm = m - i, yy = y;
        while (mm <= 0) { mm += 12; yy -= 1; }
        arr.push({ year: yy, month: mm, label: monthNames[mm - 1] + ' ' + yy });
      }
      return arr;
    }

    function buildPeriodRange(period, customFrom, customTo) {
      var nowStr = new GlideDateTime().getValue();
      var curYear  = parseInt(nowStr.substr(0, 4), 10);
      var curMonth = parseInt(nowStr.substr(5, 2), 10);
      var curDay   = parseInt(nowStr.substr(8, 2), 10);
      data.lastYear = curYear - 1;
      var startGdt = new GlideDateTime();
      var endGdt   = new GlideDateTime();
      var label = '';

      if (period === 'latest') {
        startGdt.setValue('1990-01-01 00:00:00');
        endGdt.setValue(nowStr);
        label = 'All Time (Latest)';
      } else if (period === 'previous_month') {
        var prevMonth = curMonth - 1, prevYear = curYear;
        if (prevMonth < 1) { prevMonth = 12; prevYear -= 1; }
        var dim = daysInMonth(prevYear, prevMonth);
        startGdt.setValue(prevYear + '-' + pad(prevMonth) + '-01 00:00:00');
        endGdt.setValue(prevYear + '-' + pad(prevMonth) + '-' + pad(dim) + ' 23:59:59');
        label = monthNames[prevMonth - 1] + ' ' + prevYear;
      } else if (period === 'current_year') {
        startGdt.setValue(curYear + '-01-01 00:00:00');
        endGdt.setValue(nowStr);
        label = 'Jan 1 – ' + monthNames[curMonth - 1] + ' ' + curDay + ', ' + curYear;
      } else if (period === 'last_year') {
        var lastYear = curYear - 1;
        startGdt.setValue(lastYear + '-01-01 00:00:00');
        endGdt.setValue(lastYear + '-12-31 23:59:59');
        label = 'Jan 1 – Dec 31, ' + lastYear;
      } else if (period === 'custom' && customFrom && customTo) {
        startGdt.setValue(customFrom + ' 00:00:00');
        endGdt.setValue(customTo + ' 23:59:59');
        label = customFrom + ' to ' + customTo;
      } else {
        startGdt.setValue(curYear + '-' + pad(curMonth) + '-01 00:00:00');
        endGdt.setValue(nowStr);
        label = monthNames[curMonth - 1] + ' ' + curYear;
      }
      return { start: startGdt, end: endGdt, label: label };
    }

    var range = buildPeriodRange(period, customFrom, customTo);
    data.periodLabel = range.label;
    data.statusOptions = getFilteredStatusOptions(REQUEST_TABLE, F_STATE);
    data.scorecards = { submitted: 0, approved: 0, sendback: 0, rejected: 0, deviated: 0 };

    // --- Scorecards Aggregate ---
    var agg = new GlideAggregate(REQUEST_TABLE);
    agg.addAggregate('COUNT', F_STATE);
    agg.groupBy(F_STATE);
    agg.addQuery(F_SUBMITTED_ON, '>=', range.start);
    agg.addQuery(F_SUBMITTED_ON, '<=', range.end);
    applyAppFilters(agg);
    agg.query();

    while (agg.next()) {
      var st = (agg.getValue(F_STATE) || '').toLowerCase();
      var cnt = parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT', F_STATE), 10) || 0;
      if (st.indexOf('submit') > -1) data.scorecards.submitted += cnt;
      else if (st.indexOf('approv') > -1) data.scorecards.approved += cnt;
      else if (st.indexOf('reject') > -1) data.scorecards.rejected += cnt;
    }

    var aggSB = new GlideAggregate(REQUEST_TABLE);
    aggSB.addAggregate('COUNT', F_STATE);
    aggSB.groupBy(F_STATE);
    applyAppFilters(aggSB);
    aggSB.query();

    while (aggSB.next()) {
      var st2 = (aggSB.getValue(F_STATE) || '').toLowerCase();
      if (st2.indexOf('send') > -1 || st2.indexOf('return') > -1) {
        data.scorecards.sendback += parseInt(aggSB.getAggregate('COUNT', F_STATE), 10) || 0;
      }
    }

    var devGr = new GlideAggregate(REQUEST_TABLE);
    devGr.addQuery(F_DEVIATION, true);
    devGr.addQuery(F_SUBMITTED_ON, '>=', range.start);
    devGr.addQuery(F_SUBMITTED_ON, '<=', range.end);
    devGr.addAggregate('COUNT');
    applyAppFilters(devGr);
    devGr.query();

    if (devGr.next()) {
      data.scorecards.deviated = parseInt(devGr.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0;
    }

    // --- Approval Pipeline Chart (12 months, current year) ---
    var nowStr2 = new GlideDateTime().getValue();
    var chartYear = parseInt(nowStr2.substr(0, 4), 10);
    var monthKeys = [];
    for (var mm = 1; mm <= 12; mm++) monthKeys.push(chartYear + '-' + pad(mm));

    var series = { submitted: [], approved: [], pending: [], sendback: [], rejected: [] };
    var maxVal = 1;

    monthKeys.forEach(function(mKey) {
      var parts = mKey.split('-');
      var y = parseInt(parts[0], 10), m = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
      var counts = { submitted: 0, approved: 0, pending: 0, sendback: 0, rejected: 0 };

      var ga = new GlideAggregate(REQUEST_TABLE);
      ga.addAggregate('COUNT', F_STATE);
      ga.groupBy(F_STATE);
      monthRangeQuery(ga, F_SUBMITTED_ON, y, m);
      applyAppFilters(ga);
      ga.query();

      while (ga.next()) {
        var s3 = (ga.getValue(F_STATE) || '').toLowerCase();
        var c3 = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT', F_STATE), 10) || 0;
        if (s3.indexOf('submit') > -1) counts.submitted += c3;
        else if (s3.indexOf('approv') > -1) counts.approved += c3;
        else if (s3.indexOf('pend') > -1) counts.pending += c3;
        else if (s3.indexOf('send') > -1 || s3.indexOf('return') > -1) counts.sendback += c3;
        else if (s3.indexOf('reject') > -1) counts.rejected += c3;
      }
      Object.keys(counts).forEach(function(k) {
        series[k].push(counts[k]);
        if (counts[k] > maxVal) maxVal = counts[k];
      });
    });

    data.chart = {
      year: chartYear,
      months: monthKeys.map(function(mKey) { return monthNames[parseInt(mKey.split('-')[1], 10) - 1]; }),
      series: series,
      max: maxVal
    };

    // =========================================================
    // Latest outstanding snapshot (shared by table + portfolio KPIs)
    // =========================================================
    var latestSnapMap = buildLatestSnapshotMap(scopedCodes);

    // --- Portfolio KPIs ---
    var portfolio = { totalOutstanding: 0, totalCreditLimit: 0, overdue90: 0, riskHigh: 0, riskMedium: 0, riskLow: 0 };
    scopedCodes.forEach(function(code) {
      var cust = custByCode[code];
      var snap = latestSnapMap[code];
      portfolio.totalCreditLimit += (cust ? cust.creditLimit : 0);
      if (snap) {
        portfolio.totalOutstanding += snap.total;
        portfolio.overdue90 += snap.gt90;
        var ratio = snap.total > 0 ? (snap.gt90 / snap.total) : 0;
        if (ratio >= 0.20) portfolio.riskHigh++;
        else if (ratio >= 0.05) portfolio.riskMedium++;
        else portfolio.riskLow++;
      }
    });

    var available = portfolio.totalCreditLimit - portfolio.totalOutstanding;
    var utilPct = portfolio.totalCreditLimit > 0 ? (portfolio.totalOutstanding / portfolio.totalCreditLimit * 100) : 0;

    data.portfolio = {
      totalOutstanding: formatAmt(portfolio.totalOutstanding),
      availableLimit: formatAmt(available),
      utilizationPct: utilPct.toFixed(1),
      overdue90: formatAmt(portfolio.overdue90),
      riskHigh: portfolio.riskHigh,
      riskMedium: portfolio.riskMedium,
      riskLow: portfolio.riskLow
    };

    // --- Region Risk Matrix (by CG4) ---
    var regionAgg = {};
    scopedCodes.forEach(function(code) {
      var cust = custByCode[code];
      if (!cust || !cust.region) return;
      if (!regionAgg[cust.region]) regionAgg[cust.region] = { region: cust.region, total: 0, gt90: 0 };
      var snap = latestSnapMap[code];
      if (snap) {
        regionAgg[cust.region].total += snap.total;
        regionAgg[cust.region].gt90  += snap.gt90;
      }
    });

    var regionRisk = Object.keys(regionAgg).map(function(r) {
      var row = regionAgg[r];
      var pct = row.total > 0 ? (row.gt90 / row.total * 100) : 0;
      var level = pct >= 20 ? 'Critical' : (pct >= 5 ? 'Elevated' : 'Normal');
      return {
        region: row.region,
        totalOutstanding: formatAmt(row.total),
        overdue90: formatAmt(row.gt90),
        pct: pct.toFixed(1),
        level: level
      };
    });
    regionRisk.sort(function(a, b) { return parseFloat(b.pct) - parseFloat(a.pct); });
    data.regionRisk = regionRisk;

    // --- Total Outstanding MoM Trend + Ageing Breakdown (6 months) ---
    var months6 = getLastNMonthKeys(6);
    var momSeries = [];
    var ageingSeries = { current: [], b31_60: [], b61_90: [], gt90: [] };

    months6.forEach(function(mk) {
      var monthMap = buildSnapshotMapForMonth(scopedCodes, mk.year, mk.month);
      var totalM = 0, cur = 0, b3160 = 0, b6190 = 0, gt90m = 0;
      scopedCodes.forEach(function(code) {
        var snap = monthMap[code];
        if (!snap) return;
        totalM += snap.total;
        cur    += (snap.a0_3 + snap.a4_7 + snap.a8_21 + snap.a22_30);
        b3160  += (snap.a31_45 + snap.a46_60);
        b6190  += (snap.a61_75 + snap.a76_90);
        gt90m  += snap.gt90;
      });
      momSeries.push(totalM);
      ageingSeries.current.push(cur);
      ageingSeries.b31_60.push(b3160);
      ageingSeries.b61_90.push(b6190);
      ageingSeries.gt90.push(gt90m);
    });

    data.momTrend = {
      months: months6.map(function(m) { return m.label; }),
      series: momSeries,
      max: Math.max.apply(null, momSeries.concat([1]))
    };

    var stackedMax = 1;
    months6.forEach(function(m, i) {
      var stackTotal = ageingSeries.current[i] + ageingSeries.b31_60[i] + ageingSeries.b61_90[i] + ageingSeries.gt90[i];
      if (stackTotal > stackedMax) stackedMax = stackTotal;
    });

    data.ageingBreakdown = {
      months: months6.map(function(m) { return m.label; }),
      series: ageingSeries,
      max: stackedMax
    };

    // =========================================================
    // Main List Data (Approval Requests table)
    // =========================================================
    data.requests = [];

    var reqGr = new GlideRecord(REQUEST_TABLE);
    if (statusFilter) reqGr.addQuery(F_STATE, statusFilter);
    reqGr.addQuery(F_SUBMITTED_ON, '>=', range.start);
    reqGr.addQuery(F_SUBMITTED_ON, '<=', range.end);
    applyAppFilters(reqGr);
    reqGr.orderByDesc(F_SUBMITTED_ON);
    reqGr.setLimit(500);
    reqGr.query();

    while (reqGr.next()) {
      var cust = resolveCustomer(reqGr);

      var custCode = '', custName = reqGr.getDisplayValue(F_CUSTOMER_CODE), segment = '', pan = '', zone = '', region = '', depot = '';
      var prevLimitVal = 0;
      if (cust) {
        custCode = cust.code;
        custName = cust.name || custName;
        segment  = cust.segment;
        pan      = cust.pan;
        zone     = cust.zone;
        region   = cust.region;
        depot    = cust.depot;
        prevLimitVal = cust.creditLimit;
      }

      var reqNumber = reqGr.getDisplayValue(F_REQ_NUMBER);
      var pendingAtStep = getPendingAtStep(reqGr);
      var isDev = (reqGr.getValue(F_DEVIATION) == '1' || reqGr.getValue(F_DEVIATION) == 'true');

      var statVal = reqGr.getValue(F_STATE);
      var statLabel = reqGr.getDisplayValue(F_STATE);
      if ((statVal || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('submit') > -1) {
          statLabel = 'Pending';
      }

      var outstanding = (cust && latestSnapMap[cust.code]) ? latestSnapMap[cust.code].total : 0;

      data.requests.push({
        requestCode:  reqNumber || reqGr.getUniqueValue(),
        customerCode: custCode,
        customerName: custName,
        pan:          pan,
        segment:      segment,
        zone:         zone,
        region:       region,
        depot:        depot,
        status:       statVal,
        statusLabel:  statLabel,
        isDeviation:  isDev,
        stage:        pendingAtStep,
        submittedBy:  reqGr.getDisplayValue(F_SUBMITTED_BY),
        submittedOn:  reqGr.getDisplayValue(F_SUBMITTED_ON),
        prevLimit:    formatAmt(prevLimitVal),
        requested:    formatAmt(reqGr.getValue(F_REQUESTED_AMT)),
        approved:     formatAmt(reqGr.getValue(F_APPROVED_AMT)),
        outstanding:  formatAmt(outstanding)
      });
    }

              <a ng-click="c.clearAllZones()">Clear</a>
            </div>
            <input type="text" class="clm-multiselect-search" ng-model="c.zoneSearch"
                   ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()" placeholder="Search customer groups...">
            <ul class="clm-multiselect-list">
              <li ng-repeat="z in c.getFilteredZones() track by z"
                  ng-click="$event.stopPropagation(); c.toggleZone(z)"
                  ng-class="{selected: c.isZoneSelected(z)}">
                <span class="clm-checkbox" ng-class="{checked: c.isZoneSelected(z)}"></span>
                {{z}}
              </li>
              <li class="clm-dropdown-empty" ng-if="c.getFilteredZones().length === 0">No matches</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </label>

      <!-- REGION = CG4 (MULTISELECT) -->
      <label class="clm-filter-field clm-multiselect-field">
        <span>Region</span>
        <div class="clm-multiselect-container" ng-class="{open: c.regionDropdownOpen}">
          <div class="clm-multiselect-trigger"
               ng-click="$event.stopPropagation(); c.regionDropdownOpen ? c.closeRegionDropdown() : c.openRegionDropdown()">
            <span class="clm-multiselect-text">{{c.getRegionDisplayText()}}</span>
            <i class="fa fa-chevron-down clm-multiselect-arrow"></i>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-multiselect-dropdown" ng-show="c.regionDropdownOpen" ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()">
            <div class="clm-multiselect-actions">
              <a ng-click="c.selectAllRegions()">Select All</a>
              <a ng-click="c.clearAllRegions()">Clear</a>
            </div>
            <input type="text" class="clm-multiselect-search" ng-model="c.regionSearch"
                   ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()" placeholder="Search CG4...">
            <ul class="clm-multiselect-list">
              <li ng-repeat="r in c.getFilteredRegions() track by r"
                  ng-click="$event.stopPropagation(); c.toggleRegion(r)"
                  ng-class="{selected: c.isRegionSelected(r)}">
                <span class="clm-checkbox" ng-class="{checked: c.isRegionSelected(r)}"></span>
                {{r}}
              </li>
              <li class="clm-dropdown-empty" ng-if="c.getFilteredRegions().length === 0">No matches</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </label>

      <!-- DEPOT = Sales Office (MULTISELECT) -->
      <label class="clm-filter-field clm-multiselect-field">
        <span>Depot</span>
        <div class="clm-multiselect-container" ng-class="{open: c.depotDropdownOpen}">
          <div class="clm-multiselect-trigger"
               ng-click="$event.stopPropagation(); c.depotDropdownOpen ? c.closeDepotDropdown() : c.openDepotDropdown()">
            <span class="clm-multiselect-text">{{c.getDepotDisplayText()}}</span>
            <i class="fa fa-chevron-down clm-multiselect-arrow"></i>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-multiselect-dropdown" ng-show="c.depotDropdownOpen" ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()">
            <div class="clm-multiselect-actions">
              <a ng-click="c.selectAllDepots()">Select All</a>
              <a ng-click="c.clearAllDepots()">Clear</a>
            </div>
            <input type="text" class="clm-multiselect-search" ng-model="c.depotSearch"
                   ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()" placeholder="Search sales offices...">
            <ul class="clm-multiselect-list">
              <li ng-repeat="d in c.getFilteredDepots() track by d"
                  ng-click="$event.stopPropagation(); c.toggleDepot(d)"
                  ng-class="{selected: c.isDepotSelected(d)}">
                <span class="clm-checkbox" ng-class="{checked: c.isDepotSelected(d)}"></span>
                {{d}}
              </li>
              <li class="clm-dropdown-empty" ng-if="c.getFilteredDepots().length === 0">No matches</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </label>

      <!-- STATUS -->
      <label class="clm-filter-field">
        <span>Status</span>
        <select class="form-control" ng-model="c.filters.status" ng-change="c.applyFilters()">
          <option value="">All Statuses</option>
          <option ng-repeat="s in data.statusOptions track by s.value" value="{{s.value}}">{{s.label === 'Submitted' ? 'Pending' : s.label}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>

      <!-- PERIOD -->
      <label class="clm-filter-field">
        <span>Period</span>
        <select class="form-control" ng-model="c.filters.period" ng-change="c.onPeriodChange()">
          <option ng-repeat="p in c.data.filterOpts.periods track by p.value" value="{{p.value}}">{{p.label}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
    </div>

    <!-- CUSTOM DATE RANGE -->
    <div class="clm-custom-range" ng-if="c.filters.period === 'custom'">
      <input type="date" ng-model="c.filters.customFrom">
      <span>to</span>
      <input type="date" ng-model="c.filters.customTo">
      <button type="button" class="clm-apply-btn" ng-click="c.applyFilters()">Apply Range</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ===================== Access Denied ===================== -->
  <div ng-if="data.accessDenied" class="clm-no-data" style="padding: 40px 0; background:#fff; border:1px solid #e3e6eb; border-radius:8px;">
    You do not have a role mapped to any Company Code to view this dashboard.
  </div>

  <div ng-if="!data.accessDenied">

  <!-- ===================== Approval Request Scorecards ===================== -->
  <div class="clm-scorecards">
    <div class="clm-card clm-card-blue" style="cursor: pointer;" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('pending')" ng-style="c.kpiFilter === 'pending' ? {'box-shadow': '0 0 0 2px #1c4e9c', 'background-color': '#ebf8ff'} : {}">
      <i class="fa fa-info-circle clm-kpi-info" title="Filter by Pending" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('pending'); $event.stopPropagation();"></i>
      <div class="clm-card-id">REQUESTS PENDING</div>
      <div class="clm-card-value">{{data.scorecards.submitted}}</div>
      <div class="clm-card-sub">New in {{data.periodLabel}}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="clm-card clm-card-green" style="cursor: pointer;" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('approved')" ng-style="c.kpiFilter === 'approved' ? {'box-shadow': '0 0 0 2px #38a169', 'background-color': '#e3f4ea'} : {}">
      <i class="fa fa-info-circle clm-kpi-info" title="Filter by Approved" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('approved'); $event.stopPropagation();"></i>
      <div class="clm-card-id">APPROVED</div>
      <div class="clm-card-value">{{data.scorecards.approved}}</div>
      <div class="clm-card-sub">Final approval received</div>
    </div>
    <div class="clm-card clm-card-purple" style="cursor: pointer;" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('sendback')" ng-style="c.kpiFilter === 'sendback' ? {'box-shadow': '0 0 0 2px #7c5cf0', 'background-color': '#f0e6ff'} : {}">
      <i class="fa fa-info-circle clm-kpi-info" title="Filter by Send-Back" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('sendback'); $event.stopPropagation();"></i>
      <div class="clm-card-id">SEND-BACK</div>
      <div class="clm-card-value">{{data.scorecards.sendback}}</div>
      <div class="clm-card-sub">Awaiting resubmission</div>
    </div>
    <div class="clm-card clm-card-red" style="cursor: pointer;" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('rejected')" ng-style="c.kpiFilter === 'rejected' ? {'box-shadow': '0 0 0 2px #e53e3e', 'background-color': '#fdeaea'} : {}">
      <i class="fa fa-info-circle clm-kpi-info" title="Filter by Rejected" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('rejected'); $event.stopPropagation();"></i>
      <div class="clm-card-id">REJECTED</div>
      <div class="clm-card-value">{{data.scorecards.rejected}}</div>
      <div class="clm-card-sub">Declined in {{data.periodLabel}}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="clm-card clm-card-orange" style="cursor: pointer;" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('deviated')" ng-style="c.kpiFilter === 'deviated' ? {'box-shadow': '0 0 0 2px #dd6b20', 'background-color': '#fffdf0'} : {}">
      <i class="fa fa-info-circle clm-kpi-info" title="Filter by Deviated" ng-click="c.setKpiFilter('deviated'); $event.stopPropagation();"></i>
      <div class="clm-card-id">DEVIATED REQUESTS</div>
      <div class="clm-card-value">{{data.scorecards.deviated}}</div>
      <div class="clm-card-sub">Flagged in {{data.periodLabel}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>


  <!-- ===================== Approval Pipeline Chart ===================== -->
    <div class="clm-chart-panel">
    <div class="clm-chart-header">
      <span class="clm-chart-title">Approval Pipeline — State-wise ({{data.chart.year}})</span>
      <span class="clm-chart-badge">Multi-Line</span>
      <div class="clm-legend">
        <span class="legend-item"><i class="dot blue"></i>Pending</span>
        <span class="legend-item"><i class="dot green"></i>Approved</span>
        <span class="legend-item"><i class="dot orange"></i>Stage Pending</span>
        <span class="legend-item"><i class="dot purple"></i>Send-Back</span>
        <span class="legend-item"><i class="dot red"></i>Rejected</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="clm-chart-body" ng-mouseleave="c.onMouseLeaveChart()">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 900 260" preserveAspectRatio="none" class="clm-svg" ng-if="data.chart.months.length">
        <line ng-repeat="m in data.chart.months track by $index"
              x1="{{c.chartX($index)}}" y1="0" x2="{{c.chartX($index)}}" y2="220"
              class="grid-line"></line>

        <g class="y-axis-labels">
          <text ng-repeat="tick in c.yAxisTicks"
                ng-attr-x="25"
                ng-attr-y="{{tick.y + 4}}"
                text-anchor="end"
                fill="#718096"
                style="font-size: 11px;">
            {{tick.label}}
          </text>
        </g>

        <polyline class="line-blue"    points="{{c.linePoints('submitted')}}"></polyline>
        <polyline class="line-green"   points="{{c.linePoints('approved')}}"></polyline>
        <polyline class="line-orange"  points="{{c.linePoints('pending')}}"></polyline>
        <polyline class="line-purple"  points="{{c.linePoints('sendback')}}"></polyline>
        <polyline class="line-red"     points="{{c.linePoints('rejected')}}"></polyline>

        <rect ng-repeat="m in data.chart.months track by $index"
              ng-attr-x="{{c.chartX($index) - (860 / (data.chart.months.length - 1 || 1)) / 2}}"
              y="0"
              ng-attr-width="{{860 / (data.chart.months.length - 1 || 1)}}"
              height="220"
              fill="transparent"
              style="cursor: pointer;"
              ng-mouseover="c.onMouseOverMonth($event, $index)">
        </rect>

        <g ng-repeat="m in data.chart.months track by $index">
          <text x="{{c.chartX($index)}}" y="245" class="axis-label" text-anchor="middle">{{m}}</text>
        </g>
      </svg>

      <div class="clm-chart-tooltip" ng-if="c.showTooltip" ng-style="{'left': c.tooltipLeft + 'px', 'top': c.tooltipTop + 'px'}">
        <div class="tooltip-title">{{data.chart.months[c.hoverIndex]}}</div>
        <div class="tooltip-row"><span class="tooltip-color blue"></span>Pending: {{data.chart.series.submitted[c.hoverIndex]}}</div>
        <div class="tooltip-row"><span class="tooltip-color green"></span>Approved: {{data.chart.series.approved[c.hoverIndex]}}</div>
        <div class="tooltip-row"><span class="tooltip-color orange"></span>Stage Pending: {{data.chart.series.pending[c.hoverIndex]}}</div>
        <div class="tooltip-row"><span class="tooltip-color purple"></span>Send-Back: {{data.chart.series.sendback[c.hoverIndex]}}</div>
        <div class="tooltip-row"><span class="tooltip-color red"></span>Rejected: {{data.chart.series.rejected[c.hoverIndex]}}</div>
      </div>

      <div ng-if="!data.chart.months.length" class="clm-no-data">No data available.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ===================== Data Table ===================== -->
  <div class="clm-table-panel" id="clmRequestsTableContainer">
    <div class="clm-table-header">
      <span class="clm-table-title">Approval Requests <span ng-if="c.kpiFilter" style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: normal; color: #718096; margin-left: 8px;">(Filtered by {{c.kpiFilter}})</span></span>
    </div>

    <div class="clm-table-wrapper">
      <div class="clm-search-section">
        <div class="clm-search-box">
          <i class="fa fa-search"></i>
          <input type="text" ng-model="c.filters.search" ng-change="c.runSearch()" placeholder="Search by Req ID, Name, PAN...">
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="clm-table-top-controls">
        <span class="clm-records-label">Records: <strong>{{c.getVisibleRecordsCount()}}</strong></span>
        <span class="clm-rows-label">Rows:
          <select class="clm-rows-select"
                  ng-model="c.pagination.rowsPerPage"
                  ng-change="c.onRowsPerPageChange()"
                  ng-options="opt for opt in c.rowsPerPageOptions track by opt">
          </select>
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="clm-table-scroll">
      <table class="clm-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Request ID</th>
            <th class="col-customer">Customer</th>
            <th>PAN</th>
            <th>Segment</th>
            <th class="col-zone">Zone</th>
            <th class="col-region">Region</th>
            <th class="col-depot">Sales Office</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Prev Limit</th>
            <th>Requested</th>
            <th>Approved</th>
            <th>Outstanding</th>
            <th>Pending At</th>
            <th class="col-submitted-by">Submitted By</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr ng-repeat="r in c.paginatedRequests">
            <td><a href="javascript:void(0)" class="clm-link" ng-click="c.openRequestDetail(r)">{{r.requestCode}}</a></td>
            <td class="col-customer">
              <div class="clm-cust-name" ng-click="c.openRequestDetail(r)" style="cursor: pointer;">{{r.customerName}}</div>
              <div class="clm-cust-code clm-link" ng-click="c.openRequestDetail(r)" style="cursor: pointer;">{{r.customerCode}}</div>
            </td>
            <td>{{r.pan}}</td>
            <td><span class="badge seg-badge" ng-class="c.segClass(r.segment)">{{r.segment}}</span></td>
             <td class="col-zone">{{r.zone}}</td>
            <td class="col-region">{{r.region}}</td>
            <td class="col-depot">{{r.depot}}</td>
            <td><span class="badge status-badge" ng-class="c.statusClass(r.status)">{{r.statusLabel}}</span></td>
            <td>{{r.prevLimit}}</td>
            <td>{{r.requested}}</td>
            <td>{{r.approved || '—'}}</td>
            <td>{{r.outstanding}}</td>
            <td>
              <span class="badge stage-badge" ng-if="r.stage">{{r.stage}}</span>
              <span ng-if="!r.stage">—</span>
            </td>
            <td class="col-submitted-by">{{r.submittedBy}}</td>
          </tr>
          <tr ng-if="!c.paginatedRequests.length && c.getVisibleRecordsCount()">
            <td colspan="13" class="clm-no-data">No records to display on this page.</td>
          </tr>
          <tr ng-if="c.getVisibleRecordsCount() === 0">
            <td colspan="13" class="clm-no-data">No approval requests found for the selected filters.</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div class="clm-pagination-bottom" ng-if="c.getVisibleRecordsCount() > 0">
      <div class="clm-pagination-controls">
        <button class="clm-page-btn" ng-click="c.previousPage()" ng-disabled="c.pagination.currentPage === 1">‹</button>
        <button ng-repeat="page in c.getPageNumbers()"
                class="clm-page-btn"
                ng-class="{active: page === c.pagination.currentPage}"
                ng-click="c.goToPage(page)">{{page}}</button>
        <button class="clm-page-btn" ng-click="c.nextPage()" ng-disabled="c.pagination.currentPage >= c.getTotalPages()">›</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  </div><!-- /ng-if !data.accessDenied -->
</div>]]></template></sp_widget><sys_es_latest_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><id>14bc58192b1a07904572f3745e91bf5b</id><sys_created_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-24 08:51:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>5cbc58192b1a07904572f3745e91bf60</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-24 08:51:20</sys_updated_on><table>sp_widget</table><use_es_latest>true</use_es_latest></sys_es_latest_script></record_update>
